Name: Grandpa Legacy
Author: asimdev
Description:
Grandpa's Legacy is a single-player SMAPI mod that accelerates game progression at the start of a save.
[list]
[*]Community Center is unlocked at game start, and fully completed[/*]
[*]New dialogue available with villagers. [/*]
[/list]THIS MOD IS INTENDED TO BE USED WITH A NEW SAVE

[b]Shout outs[/b]
[b]Char for the idea :)[/b]

Downloads.Description: This update addresses an issue with the initial version - none of the actual unlocks from the community center being completed were available!

Manifest.Name: Grandpa Legacy
Manifest.Description: Starts saves with near-complete bundles and immediate Community Center access.
